payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_parent_versions.py::test_a_childs_diff_pairs_each_killed_version_of_each_parent_whose_witness_it_edits stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/parent_versions.py. The claim was "`parent_version_pairs` in the new `saffron/parent_versions.py` pairs each killed wrong version of each parent whose witness the diff edits. Its keywords are `depends_on`, `specs_dir`, `out_dir` and `diff`. A parent is a spec `depends_on` names, read from `specs_dir`'s retired directory or from `specs_dir` itself, taken in `depends_on` order. A name neither directory declares is left out, and a file in either that does not parse is skipped. A missing retired directory reads as empty, as `scheduler._retired_ids` reads it. A changed path is the path each `diff --git` block of `diff` names. `names_file(witness, path)` holds when the witness begins with the path and the next character, if any, is neither a letter, a digit nor one of `_`, `.`, `-` and `/`. A parent criterion is chosen when it declares wrong versions and `names_file` holds for its witness and some changed path. A parent's chosen criteria are read in declared order. Its record is `out_dir / <parent id> / wrong-versions.json`. Each entry whose `witness` equals the criterion's adds each of its versions whose `outcome` is `killed`, in recorded order. Each pair is that parent criterion and an entry holding `parent`, `witness`, `version`, the recorded `edit` and an empty `reason`. The function returns the pairs and an empty second list. The witness first asserts `names_file` true for a `::` suffix, a space suffix and the bare path. It asserts it false for a letter, a digit, `_`, `.`, `-` or `/` after the path, for another file, and for the path preceded by a directory. Its diff modifies tests/test_a.py, then src/a.py, then tests/test_c.py. It builds retired parents `SP-1` and `SP-2`, a retired non-parent `SP-4`, a queued parent `SP-3` and a queued non-parent `SP-5`. A `README.md` in the retired directory and a `broken.md` in the queue have no frontmatter. `depends_on` is `SP-3`, `SP-1`, `SP-7` and `SP-2`, and no file declares `SP-7`. `SP-1` declares four criteria, with witnesses on tests/test_a.py, tests/test_a.pyi, tests/test_b.py and tests/test_c.py, in that order. `SP-2`'s one witness is on tests/test_c.py. `SP-3`'s witness is the bare path tests/test_a.py. `SP-4` and `SP-5` each have one witness on tests/test_a.py. `SP-1`'s record holds killed, survived, unproven, error and killed versions under its first witness. It holds one killed version under each of its other three witnesses. It also holds one under `test_old` on tests/test_a.py, a witness no criterion declares. Every other record holds one killed version under its spec's witness. The witness asserts the exact pairs, each criterion's claim and witness included. `SP-1`'s pair from its fourth criterion comes after `k2`. It then builds a specs directory with no retired directory and the queued `SP-3`, and asserts `SP-3`'s one pair and an empty second list.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_parent_versions.py::test_a_parent_whose_record_cannot_be_read_is_named_and_pairs_nothing, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
